title: Orthogonal projection onto W ⊕ ℝu for a unit vector u orthogonal to W (parent step 2)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, E := ℝ^N (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) with inner product x·y and norm |·|, W ⊆ E a linear subspace with orthogonal projection P := W.starProjection, and u ∈ W^⊥ with |u| = 1. Let H := W ⊔ span{u} with orthogonal projection p := H.starProjection. Then p(y) = P(y) + (y·u)u for every y ∈ E.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)) (u : Rn N), u ∈ Wᗮ → ‖u‖ = 1 → ∀ y : Rn N, (W ⊔ Submodule.span ℝ {u}).starProjection y = W.starProjection y + inner ℝ y u • u
